","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":13,"lineHeight":1.5,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"caption","elementType":"text","bounds":[56,434,600,18],"content":{"text":"真实截图：HUANDENG Editor 中文界面，公开示例项目“HUANDENG 产品示例”。","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.4,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"ft-mark","elementType":"image","bounds":[56,505,16,16],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png","sourceName":"huandeng.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"ft-label","elementType":"text","bounds":[78,505,600,16],"content":{"text":"HUANDENG / 我做了什么","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","middle"]}},{"elementId":"ft-pos","elementType":"text","bounds":[824,505,80,16],"content":{"text":"0","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["right","middle"],"field":"main-position"}}] notes: "这就是编辑器本身，打开的是一个小的公开示例。1，侧栏有四个页签：项目、页面、素材、文件；文件页像 VS Code 显示代码仓库一样显示项目目录。素材是一个真正的素材库：项目里的每张图、它的原始尺寸、在哪些页面用到。2，画布上方的视图：普通、浏览、大纲、章节、备注页和历史。3，画布编辑原生对象，包括表格和图表。4，属性面板：属性、布局、借鉴 Photoshop 的图层面板、这一页的故事，以及检查。5，助手连接用来接入你已经在用的 AI 客户端；动态里能看到它主动上报的工作和实际保存的修改，两者分开显示。6，导出和放映。编辑器里没有内置聊天框。"
